title: Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index (Oct 2026)
source: CB: conference-board.org/topics/consumer-confidence — the page states verbatim "The next release is Tuesday, October 27th at 10 AM ET.", fetched direct 2026-10-18 (plain curl with a desktop user-agent, HTTP 200, 333,636 bytes; the same page that on 2026-08-29 named 09-29 only). Promoted estimate -> confirmed by this event's own pulse on the primary line its 2026-08-29 initial research said was missing
notes: Matters disproportionately in one branch: the Conference Board is a PRIVATE publisher and survives a lapse in federal appropriations, where BLS does not. If FY2027 funding lapses on 2026-09-30, the 10-02 payrolls and 10-14 CPI are deleted permanently (2025 precedent) and this print lands inside that blackout, the day before an FOMC carrying no SEP — one of the few forward-looking consumer reads still being published. In the averted branch it is an ordinary second-tier print. Discovered during the consumer-confidence-2026-09-29 initial research. Update 2026-10-18: the funding-lapse branch died (CR signed 2026-09-02, funds through 12-11), so this is an ordinary second-tier survey; the 09-29 print fell to 81.9 and the Board now names this date itself.
